automationNotes: Steps mirror the document in order: Install section → Use section (Dashboard). Install steps are click-only per user instruction. Doc says 'Marketplace icon in left nav' — automation uses App Switcher (docWarning). After landing on Marketplace: verify heading, verify+click Apps from left panel, type app name in search, hover card and install. Install popup uses cs-select dropdown. ToS checkbox is warnOnly. After install, doc shows 'Open Stack' — automation uses Stacks left nav icon (docWarning). Dashboard widget renders inside an iframe — actionRules has a special frameLocator handler for all CTV widget targets (card, info panel, JSON view, search, reload, fullscreen). Zoom in/out/recenter are warnOnly (iframe toolbar buttons with no accessible name). Referenced Content Types is warnOnly (optional field).
